volume_rsi.reference: RSI_Volume / calc_rsi_volume with WiMA, shared verbatim by the FMZ copies (Johny's BOT, Dual Laser, Quant Trend, Indicator Verification, exlux99 RSI Curve); first publisher not traced
volume_rsi.notes: WiMA is Wilder's recursion seeded at 0 (not ta.rma's SMA seed), so early values differ from an SMA-seeded RSI (the reviewers' warmup_only verdict). All 5 copies are identical.

cipher_b_rsimfi.notes: sma((close-open)/(high-low)*mult, period) - posY; a flat bar gives na for `period` bars as in Pine. The scripts' request.security HTF variant is not included: pass resampled bars for another timeframe. One copy (Indicators-Combination-Breakthrough) uses 80 / 200 / 2.

strategy_issues.issue: These copies embed an altered VADER: R = (highest(1) - lowest(1)) / 2 is half the current bar's range although the comment says '2-bar average bar range' (RedK uses highest(2)/lowest(2)); no fixnan on c, so a zero-range bar makes c na and the WMAs na for `length` bars; adp/asp scaled x1 instead of x100.

redk_vader.notes: The RedK files match bar for bar (v3 and v4 differ only in defaults/plots). f_RelVol uses ta.stoch over highest/lowest of volume, so its effective window is 2n-1 (kept as published). Outputs demand, supply, vader, signal (wma(vader, smooth)), sentiment.

nadaraya_watson_rq.reference: jdehorty, 'Nadaraya-Watson: Rational Quadratic Kernel (Non-Repainting)' https://www.tradingview.com/script/AWNvbPRM-Nadaraya-Watson-Rational-Quadratic-Kernel-Non-Repainting/ ; same kernel as rationalQuadratic in jdehorty's KernelFunctions https://www.tradingview.com/script/e0Ek9x99-KernelFunctions/

strategy_issues.issue: customKernel weights use (x_0 - i)^2 instead of i^2 and loop only i = 0..h (9 bars): the kernel is centred 25 bars in the past, so within the 9-bar window the OLDEST bar gets the largest weight. Not jdehorty's estimator (which spans size + x_0 + 1 = 27 bars with the newest bar weighted most).

nadaraya_watson_rq.notes: Defaults h 8, r 8, x_0 25, lag 2; na until bar size + x_0 + 1 = 26. Lupown's copy (基于核回归和ATR动态波段...) is faithful and matches bar for bar. Unrelated to LuxAlgo's Gaussian NADARAYA_WATSON envelope already in tv_indicators.

p_signal.reference: P-Signal Strategy and P-Signal Strategy RVS [Kharevsky]: sma(fErf(sma/stdev/sqrt2) of change(ohlc4), n), n = points - 1

files: 基于高斯误差函数的量化交易策略An-Analysis-of-Quantitative-Trading-Strategy-Based-on-Gaussian-Error-Function.md
strategy_issues.issue: v4 fPSignal evaluates fErf(1.0) = 0.8427 whenever stdev is not > 0, including the warm-up when stdev is na, so the first bars read a bullish 0.84 instead of na and a flat window is bullish regardless of the mean. Kharevsky's own v5 RVS script (f5635ee110ed) replaces this with sign(sma).

p_signal.notes: Both variants are implemented: version=4 (default, the original P-Signal Strategy) and version=5 (RVS). fErf is the script's Numerical-Recipes erfc approximation (|err| < 1.2e-7), kept for bar-for-bar equality. Pass ohlc4 as the source; the multi-timeframe copy applies it to W/M security data too.

delta_rsi.notes: Local polynomial least-squares fit (degree 2, window 21) of RSI(21); drsi = slope at the newest point, nrmse = RMSE / window mean, signal = ema(drsi, 9). numpy pinv replaces the script's modified Gram-Schmidt QR pseudoinverse; the test ports the MGS QR literally and agrees to ~1e-10. All 3 copies identical.

zvwap.reference: ZVWAP / Z distance from VWAP [LazyBear], pds 20
zvwap.notes: Each bar's squared deviation is from that bar's own rolling VWAP (as published). mohanee's copy generalises the source (calc_zvwap(pds, source1)) but calls it with close.

gaussian_weighted_stdev.reference: f_gaussian / f_gaussian_std in 'Gaussian Channel + Stoch RSI Strategy' (FMZ 482786)
gaussian_weighted_stdev.notes: Gaussian weights centred on the middle of the trailing window (sigma = length/6), mean and weighted stdev around it; outputs mid, stdev, upper, lower. Not DonovanWall's Gaussian Channel (fmz_catalog.extra.gaussian_channel); being centred, mid lags ~(n-1)/2 bars.

vw_stdev.notes: vw_deviation_bands(close, volume, length=60, kind='stdev'); basis = rolling volume-weighted mean (= ta.vwma), bands +/-2 and +/-3 dev, optional log space.

vawsi.reference: vawma / vawsi in 'VAWSI and Trend Persistance Reversal' (FMZ strategy)
vawsi.notes: Weights (volume/sma(volume,n) + tr/sma(tr,n))/2 over n+1 bars (the loop is 0..length), averages taken at the current bar. Takes a `src` input (the strategy uses the Heikin Ashi close) and chart high/low/close for ta.atr(1). The strategy's length is a per-bar series from BlackCat1402's Ehlers dominant cycle; here length is a fixed parameter.

blackflag_fts.reference: Blackflag FTS (Jose Azcarate; v4 study by Duyck), defaults modified / 28 / 5; source copy https://c.mql5.com/21/448/blackflag.txt , discussion https://prorealcode.com/topic/blackflag-fts-indicator

strategy_issues.issue: 'Blackflag FTS signal' is invented: up and down both accumulate high - low, so up/down = 1 and fts_value = 100 - 100/2 = 50 on every bar (na for the first 13). The buy filter fts_value > 0 is always true and the sell condition fts_value < 0 never fires. Blackflag FTS is an ATR trailing stop, not an RSI-style ratio.

blackflag_fts.notes: Implemented the real indicator: trail (stop), trend (+1/-1), extremum (na until the first trend change, as Pine's max(na, x)), fib1/2/3 = 61.8/78.6/88.6 % zones. Both trail types tested against a port of the published source.

weighted_stdev.notes: weighted_stdev(close, weight, length) -> mean, variance (unbiased with non-zero-weight count), dev, mse, rmse; the strategy uses weight = volume. weighted_stdev_linear is the arrays example (weights n..1, newest heaviest; mean = ta.wma).

files: 历史波动率区间突破交易策略Volatility-Range-Breakout-Trading-Strategy.md
strategy_issues.issue: The bands use the script's wma(priceType, length, weight) with weight = the current bar's volatility for every term, so the weight cancels and the 'volatility-weighted' average is a plain SMA (na only when volatility is 0). Ported as written.

range_volatility.notes: volatility = 2(highest-lowest)/(highest+lowest); outputs volatility, upper, lower, mid.

volume_pressure.reference: Volume Strength Finder [Saravanan_Ragavan] as embedded in 多指标趋势追踪策略 (session anchor 09:15)

strategy_issues.issue: On a session's first bar L = 1 and 'for i = 1 to L - 1' becomes 'for i = 1 to 0', which Pine runs backwards (i = 1, 0): it adds the previous session's last bar and the current unfinished bar instead of nothing. Implemented with an empty sum there (pos/neg na). Also na before the first 09:15 bar (Z1 na).

volume_pressure.notes: Generalised the 09:15 anchor to a `session` id input (ti.session_ids(index, 'D')). A flat bar (high == low) makes the session's sums na from then on, as in Pine. Matches the copy on every bar except a session's first bar.

vwap_deviation.notes: Same snippet family as vw_mean_abs_dev (the for-loop body of pine_vwavdev).

tmo.reference: True Momentum Oscillator, Mobius (thinkorswim 2018): fold i = 0 to length of sign(close - open[i]), ExpAverage 5 then 3, signal ExpAverage 3 (defaults 14/5/3) https://usethinkscript.com/threads/tmo-true-momentum-oscillator-for-thinkorswim.9413/ ; TV port https://www.tradingview.com/script/o9BQyaA4-True-Momentum-Oscillator/

strategy_issues.issue: Loops i = 1..tmolength-1, dropping Mobius' i = 0 term (close vs the current bar's open), so the count has length-1 terms. Reproduce with tmo(..., start=1) (tested).

tmo.notes: Default start=0 follows Mobius' fold. Uses ta.ema (SMA seed) like the Pine ports; thinkScript's ExpAverage seeds with the first value, so the first bars differ slightly. Strategy inputs 45/12/9.

for_loop_score.reference: forloop_analysis in 'Zero Lag Trend Strategy' [josephdelvecchio] (FMZ strategy)
for_loop_score.notes: Score = sum over lags start..end of sign(x - x[i]); lags beyond history count 0 (Pine na compare). Apply to the zero-lag EMA as the strategy does.

price_friction.notes: friction = sum of (1+bb)/(i+bb) over previous bars whose range contains close; outputs friction, low_f, high_f, mid_f, trigger (the strategy reads mid_f[5] / trigger[5]).

vw_mean_abs_dev.reference: BabyShark VWAP [GreatestUsername]: pine_vwavdev ('Average Deviation', the script's setting)
vw_mean_abs_dev.notes: vw_deviation_bands(close, volume, length=60, kind='average'), deviations from the current bar's volume-weighted mean.

rsi_heikin_ashi.notes: Zero-centred RSI candles Heikin-Ashi-ed; the FMZ strategy uses length 14, smoothing 7. Only the HA candles, not HARSI's stoch/RSI plots.

relative_body_index.notes: ema(sum((close-open)/(high-low), n), n) (binary=True: +1 bull / -1 otherwise); signal = ema(rbi, 5). A flat bar gives na for n bars.

hurst_exponent.reference: Rescaled-range Hurst exponent (Hurst 1951 / Mandelbrot), single window of n log returns: H = log(R/S)/log(n)

files: 基于多时间周期赫斯特指数与斐波那契回撤的动态趋势交易策略Multi-Timeframe-Hurst-Exponent-and-Fibonacci-Retracement-Dynamic-Trend-Trading-Strategy.md
strategy_issues.issue: calcHurst is not R/S: dev = src - sma(src) uses each bar's own rolling mean, cumDev is a rolling sum of those deviations (not the cumulative profile inside one window), R = highest - lowest of that rolling sum over another len bars (2len-1 bars in all), and it works on price levels instead of returns, with S = stdev of prices. The value has no fixed relation to 0.5, which the strategy uses as its trend threshold.

hurst_exponent.notes: Correct single-window estimate; biased upward for small n (~0.6 for a random walk at n = 50). Not ported: the strategy's daily request.security call.

weis_wave_volume.notes: The strategy uses trendDetectionLength 4 and the non-negative dn (below_zero=False); both tested bar for bar.

faytterro_estimator.notes: estimator = cr(src, 2n-1) = ti.trima(src, 2n-1) exactly (tested), so the smoothing itself exists; added the quadratic extrapolation (dizi[len+6]) and the raw buy/sell turns before the strategy's price-gap filters. Past data only (unlike faytterro's repainting indicator).

files: 基于轨迹平均振幅的多时igkeit交易策略Gyroscopic-Bands-Strategy-Based-on-Multi-Time-Frame-and-Average-Amplitude.md
strategy_issues.issue: Warm-up quirks, ported as written: 'pos := a <= 5 ? close : nz(pos[1])' is overwritten on the same bar, so pos starts near 0; it reaches the price only through traj's one-off close[1] - nz(close[2]) = close jump at bar 1, which decays with factor b/(b+1). grav = 10^a / close is price-scale dependent (tuned for BTC).

gyroscopic_trajectory.notes: traj = (close[1]-close[2] + traj[1]*b)/(b+1); outputs pos, upper, lower, traj. Discard the first several x b bars.

vawsi_hln.reference: hln in 'VAWSI and Trend Persistance Reversal' (FMZ strategy)
vawsi_hln.notes: The script's custom rma sums a window and then overwrites it with nz(rma[1])*(n-1)/n + x/n, so it is a 0-seeded Wilder MA (dead code, behaviour kept). hln = 100*|change(rma(TR))|/src, na when the change is 0.

volume_profile.reference: Rolling volume profile (POC / VAH / VAL) over the last N bars; value area per TradingView's procedure https://www.tradingview.com/support/solutions/43000502040-volume-profile/
volume_profile.notes: The work-list snippet (b8dae24f3e5b, 'Buy and Sell Volume Heatmap') is not a profile: it sums volume of the previous 100 bars at 10 levels close*(1 +/- k*1%) and only colours labels. Ported separately as volume_heatmap (matches the copy bar for bar). volume_profile: rows over the window's [lowest low, highest high], each bar's volume spread uniformly over its range (TV uses lower-timeframe bars), POC = middle of the max row, value area expanded one row at a time by the larger neighbour (ties: closer, then above) without exceeding 70 %; vah/val are row edges. Recomputed each bar from the last N bars (current bar included), no repaint; tested against a plain-Python profile and a future-perturbation check.

vpci.reference: Volume Price Confirmation Indicator, Buff Dormeier (TASC July 2007 'Between Price and Volume'); LazyBear's TV port https://www.tradingview.com/script/lmTqKOsa-Indicator-Volume-Price-Confirmation-Indicator-VPCI/
vpci.notes: VPCI = (vwma_long - sma_long) * (vwma_short / sma_short) * (sma(vol, short) / sma(vol, long)); defaults 5/20, strategy 5/25. The smoothed VPCI / Bollinger lines are not included (their exact definition could not be confirmed).
